# Core Rule 5 ## English is the required language for all communication.
- [color=#d93c3c][bold]All communication on the server—both in-character (IC) and out-of-character (OOC) must be in English.[/bold][/color] - This includes [color=#b8860b]roleplay[/color], [color=#b8860b]OOC chat[/color], [color=#b8860b]ahelp[/color], and [color=#b8860b]staff messages[/color].
[italic][color=#2e9e4f]This ensures clear communication between players and staff, and helps maintain a fair, inclusive environment.[/color][/italic]
